drawings.alt: AAG frame and blade profile — Front Horizontal Blades (AAG-DH) and Front Vertical Blades (AAG-DV)

notes: L = Listed size = duct size. N = Neck size = L − 5 mm.
Front blades run horizontal (AAG-DH) or vertical (AAG-DV); enter Width, Height and Blade Deflection in the Parameters panel to look up this size's area factor and performance.
Listed sizes and area factors are grouped by common free-area factor (Table 1.3); exact frame and flange dimensions are available on request from Air Master.
